sources.title: Westchester County Board of Elections: Party Petitions Filed 4-18-2025 (archived copy; original no longer on the BOE site)
Westchester County Board of Elections: 2025 Primary Election Candidate List (6-4) (archived copy)
Westchester County Board of Elections: 2025 June Primary Election Canvass (Yonkers County Committee - Republican, pp. 67-85)
Westchester County Board of Elections: 2025 General Election Canvass (ED list from County Executive pages)

notes: Westchester Republicans elect county committee in odd years; the June 24, 2025 primary is the most recent election (the 2026 primary ballot list shows only Democratic county committee contests). Filing basis: the BOE's 'Party Petitions Filed 4-18-2025' list (marked 'subject to change'), counting REP County Committee Member filers with status E (a person listed on two petitions in the same ED counted once); status I entries (104) were treated as invalid, which matches the final 6-4 ballot list (e.g. Yonkers 250209 and 250301). Declinations or court rulings after 4/18/2025 are not reflected for uncontested EDs. Seats: 2 per ED ('VOTE FOR TWO' on the BOE ballot list). 19 Yonkers EDs were contested (some via opportunity-to-ballot petitions); winners taken from the certified 2025 primary canvass. In Yonkers Ward 6 ED 6 both seats were won by write-in candidates over the sole filer, so they are marked unknown (write-in acceptance not verified). ED list (906 EDs) and names from the 2025 general election canvass, which matches every ED code in the petition list. One ED had more valid filers than seats but no contest on the final ballot (Yonkers 250206, City of Yonkers Ward 2 ED 6); its seats are marked unknown.
